# 2ndBrain Markdown Viewer

> A high-performance, client-side Markdown note assistant and previewer with GitHub styling, MathJax, Mermaid diagrams, and zero tracking.

## Overview
2ndBrain is a privacy-first, client-side markdown workspace that runs entirely in the user's browser. All data remains local with no backend storage.

## Key Resources
- [Markdown Viewer Application](https://md.khanhdp.com/): Interactive markdown editor, previewer, and note workspace
- [Source Code Repository](https://github.com/khanhduong22/md-preview): Open-source repository, issues, and documentation

## Features
- **Live GitHub Preview**: Real-time rendering with GitHub markdown styling
- **Diagrams & Math**: Integrated Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX mathematics
- **Local Vault Storage**: Private, persistent local storage with tab management
- **Zero-Friction Sharing**: Client-side stateless URL sharing with optional view modes
- **Export Options**: Standalone HTML, Markdown, and formatted PDF export
